target_definition: exact U0=exp(-i H step); direct U0^k; iterative V_(k-1) @ U0
reported_hs_fidelity: abs(Tr(target^dagger V))^2/d^2; all d basis states, never a B32 trace estimate
test_policy: fresh independent product test set per k; diagnostics only, never depth/parameter selection
depth_policy: scan 1..k+extra_depth; minimum passing selection threshold, otherwise best available
initialization_policy: analytic, depth warm start with zero added angles, scaled previous-k warm start, Gaussian jitter restarts

resource_notes.actual: classical exact statevector/matrix simulation with analytic adjoint gradients; zero quantum shots
resource_notes.estimates: hypothetical gate-wise parameter-shift plus echo (B32) or 2n-qubit HST (full); not measured runtime or shots
resource_notes.target_caveat: exact dense U0 targets have no specified hardware synthesis; gate costs use a separate alternating-Trotter proxy, whose fidelity is audited per selected block
resource_notes.preparation: B32 overhead <=4n single gates and depth<=4; conservative also for pauli6
resource_notes.excluded: hardware mapping, error mitigation, readout/reset time, classical-to-quantum latency
resource_notes.resume: complete attempts reused; incomplete attempts archived and counted, then restarted

compatible_io_revisions.reason: Windows WinError 5 during atomic checkpoint replacement; bounded retry only
